heading.title: A physical standby
heading.brief: Pin versions, seed an owned replica and follow WAL locations; distinguish byte-identical physical history from independently changed rows.

heading.title: Receipt and replay
heading.brief: Pause replay deliberately and inspect received, flushed and replayed progress; explain hot-standby conflicts and log retention.

heading.title: Acknowledgement and routing
heading.brief: Choose synchronous acknowledgement semantics and read-after-write routing from the shop’s contract; demonstrate what each native progress signal proves.

heading.title: Promotion and return
heading.brief: Fence the original writer before promotion, verify the new timeline and explain rewind eligibility or reseeding; record any missing committed history.
